basis: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION; no measured site telemetry
canonical_time: RFC3339 UTC with explicit offset. Unique (site_id,timestamp), hourly. Local display uses IANA zones; never assume 8760 rows/year.

units.*_mw: MW average over hour, numerically MWh in one-hour intervals

site_hourly.csv.accounting: facility_mw = it_mw + cooling_mw + other_mw. Source_mw is thermal and capped by the original assumed 2.5 MW recovery tranche. Heat-plant compressor and pumping electricity are additional, never included in these three measured/simulated facility components.

customer_registry.csv.notes: Register routes and capacity separately for every simultaneous customer. Customer demand is delivered useful thermal power, not purchased electricity.

weather_forecasts.csv.availability: issue_timestamp <= decision issue; valid timestamp alone is insufficient. Realized future ambient_c is prohibited as a feature.

exogenous_forecasts.csv.availability: Only previously issued forecasts or truly committed tariffs/maintenance may be used. Unannounced outages are unknown.

storage_registry.csv.notes: SOC is useful thermal energy. Temperature eligibility is enforced by dispatch. Terminal SOC cannot be freely liquidated.

feature_rules: Decision at end of issue hour; forecast horizons are issue+1 through issue+24.
All telemetry feature indices must be <= issue index.
Seasonal lags use valid time minus 24 or 168 hours, guaranteed observed for horizons <=24.
Known calendar, independently issued weather predictions and maintenance schedules may describe future timestamps.
Quality-marked bad telemetry is forward filled from earlier good observations for lag features. Current stale/missing telemetry triggers a labeled conservative fallback.
Do not infer accuracy at either named site from synthetic holdout scores.
external_ingestion: validate_csv() rejects naive timestamps, duplicates, non-hourly site sequences, impossible powers and facility-accounting mismatch. External ingestion is validated and preserved separately; it does not overwrite the reproducible synthetic training set or silently train a model.
